description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530012662097 BRAKE SHOE SET: Line 0001 Qty 151 UI SE Deliver To: By: 0075 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
